source: City of Naga Ordinance No. 2025-070 (LTFRB-DOTr Board Resolution No. 204, s. 2025), with Sangguniang Panlungsod Resolution No. 2025-172
note: Transcribed from the ordinance's route table (see the extracted text beside this file). Entrance runs from the barangay to Centro, exit returns; loops are split at their far point. Loops A and B turn at Bicol Central Station on Roxas Avenue; C and D at J. Miranda Avenue.

routes.outbound: Elias Angeles St. – Panganiban Drive – Dayangdang St. – Balatas Rd. – Cararayan-San Isidro Rd.
